title: Lander–Parkin–Selfridge
statement: If sum(a_i^k, i=1,…,m)=sum(b_j^k, j=1,…,n) for positive integers with a_i≠b_j for every i,j, then m+n≥k.

counterexample.description: Equal sums of like \(k\)th powers with \(m+n<k\), excluding cancellation; the simplest target is \(a^5+b^5=c^5+d^5\). Exact exponentiation verifies a tuple.
